headline: Reserve Bank of India Conducts State Government Securities Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced the results of a state government securities auction, including a re-issue of Andhra Pradesh's 7.68% SGS 2051 bonds at a cut-off yield of 8.1280%.
why: State government securities are a key component of India's debt market, and auction results provide insight into regional fiscal health and prevailing interest rate expectations.

impacts.name: Indian Government Bonds
impacts.why: Auction results set the benchmark yield for state-level debt.
